items.extra: This must NOT look fitted, tailored or slim in any way. The real product is a loose, boxy, oversized unisex-cut fleece set. Drop-shoulder seam sits well below the natural shoulder point, partway down the upper arm. Sleeves are long and loose with visible slack, bunching before the wrist bone, never tight against the forearm. The jacket body has clear extra room — visible slouch and soft folds at the sides and front, not skimming the torso. Hem sits loose at the hip, not cinched in. The jogger legs are wide and loose all the way down the thigh and calf, fabric puddling slightly above the elasticated ankle cuff, never tapered or skin-tight against the leg. Match the loose, boxy silhouette in the garment reference photo exactly — that photo is the real product, not a design suggestion. Two front patch pockets must be clearly visible low on the jacket front, one on each side — an actual visible pocket opening/bag, not just an implied seam line — matching the garment reference photo.

Change ONLY the colour of the jacket and jogger to a dark charcoal grey, approximately #434551. Keep every seam, the zip, the collar, the ribbing, every fold and highlight, the skin, hair, face, backdrop and floor pixel-identical to the base image.
